## Added
- **Mega Trees** — planting a 2×2 of birch, oak, acacia, or cherry saplings now grows a giant tree, the same way vanilla already handles jungle and spruce:
  - **Birch / Oak** — tall straight 2×2 giants (11–28 blocks).
  - **Acacia** — a spreading, flat-topped savanna umbrella.
  - **Cherry** — a stubby, wide bonsai with a drooping pink canopy.
  - Player-planted only (never generates naturally in the world). Toggle in the config; on by default.

## Changed
- **Villager Stock** — default trade-stock multiplier lowered from 4× to 2×.
